name: frontend-workbench
description: Composable guards and workflows for frontend implementation, interface copy, product design, and visual direction.

interface.shortDescription: Composable workflows for frontend product work
interface.longDescription: An extensible frontend plugin with project-architecture and user-facing-copy guards, research-led product design, and concept-first visual art direction as composable skills.
defaultPrompt: Use $frontend-project-fit to implement this frontend change with the project's existing architecture and reusable UI.
Use $frontend-copy-guard to audit and fix user-facing UI copy without exposing technical or internal logic.
Use $frontend-product-design to research and justify this UI or UX design before implementation.
